body:
Privacy Policy — Sirat Companion

Last updated: November 9, 2026
Effective date: November 9, 2026
Applies to: Sirat Companion version 4.0.2 and later

INTRODUCTION

Sirat Companion ("the App", "we", "us", or "our") is an Islamic companion application for HarmonyOS, developed by Sharjeel Idris ("the Developer"). This Privacy Policy explains what information the App accesses, how that information is used, and your rights regarding that information.

We have designed Sirat Companion to process your personal data entirely on your device. The App does not require an account, does not transmit your personal data to us or to any third party, and does not use tracking or analytics servers. To provide the Offline Mosque Finder feature, the App connects to a public Content Delivery Network (CDN) solely to download static database files.

By installing and using the App, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

INFORMATION WE ACCESS AND USE

Sirat Companion accesses the following information solely on your device to provide its features. None of this personal information is transmitted to us, to Huawei, or to any third party by the App.

Location Information
- What we access: Your device's GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude), and — when you choose Manual Location — the coordinates you type in.
- Why we access it: Location is required to calculate accurate prayer times, the Qibla direction, and to find nearby mosques using the Offline Mosque Finder.
- How it is stored: The last successful location (coordinates and city name) is cached on your device so the App can load quickly. You can clear this at any time by switching to Manual Location or by uninstalling the App.
- Transmission: The App does not send your location to any server. The Nearby Mosque search is performed entirely locally on your device after the database is downloaded. If reverse geocoding is enabled, the request is handled by your device's operating system geocoder, subject to Huawei's privacy policy.

Custom Mosques
- What we access: If you manually add or edit a mosque, the App stores the name, address, and coordinates you provide.
- Why we access it: To display your custom mosques alongside the downloaded offline OpenStreetMap data and to allow you to navigate to them.
- How it is stored: Custom mosque data is stored locally on your device using the HarmonyOS Preferences API. It never leaves your device unless you have enabled system backup.

Network Access & Offline Data (Mosque Finder)
- What we access: The App uses your internet connection to download public OpenStreetMap mosque data (in the form of `.db` files) from a public CDN (jsDelivr/GitHub).
- Why we access it: To enable the Offline Mosque Finder to work without needing a constant internet connection.
- Transmission: When you download a country pack, the App requests the specific database file. No personal information, GPS coordinates, or device identifiers are sent to the CDN during this download. The search for nearby mosques happens 100% locally on your device.

Sensor Information
- What we access: The device's orientation sensor and magnetometer.
- Why we access it: Required for the Qibla compass to determine which direction is true north and where the Kaaba is relative to your device.
- Transmission: Sensor readings are processed entirely on your device and are never stored or transmitted.

Prayer Completion History
- What we access: The prayers you mark as prayed each day (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha), stored per calendar date.
- Why we access it: To power the Home dashboard and the Prayer Details page — today's progress, streaks, weekly and monthly summaries, and lifetime statistics — and to skip creating reminders for prayers you have already performed.
- How it is stored: Stored locally on your device using the HarmonyOS Preferences API. It never leaves your device unless you have enabled system backup, in which case it participates in the backup described in the "Backup and Restore" section below.

Prayer Times and Settings
- What we access: Your calculation preferences (convention, Asr rule, prayer offsets, high-latitude rule, rounding, midnight method, polar resolution, Shafaq), app theme, dark mode, language preference, time format, Hijri date offset, Hijri calendar type, location mode, manual coordinates, event tradition preference, per-timing visibility toggles, vibration preference, Tasbih theme preferences, Tasbih sound preference, and notification preferences.
- Why we access it: To remember your choices across app restarts.
- How it is stored: All preferences are stored locally on your device using the HarmonyOS Preferences API. They never leave your device unless you have enabled system backup.

Tasbih Data
- What we access: The Tasbih sessions you create, the dhikr items within them, your current counts, your daily totals, a rolling 90-day history of daily counts per dhikr, and the theme chosen for each Tasbih. You can optionally associate Tasbihs with specific prayers.
- Why we access it: To display and persist your Tasbih progress on the Tasbih tab and on the Tasbih Details page, and to show contextual Tasbih reminders alongside your daily prayers.
- How it is stored: Tasbih data is stored locally on your device using the HarmonyOS Preferences API. Daily counts are automatically rolled into history each night. Nothing is transmitted unless you have enabled system backup.

System Feedback State
- What we access: The device's current ringer mode (ring / vibrate / silent) and the system haptics toggle.
- Why we access it: So that the App's own sound and vibration respect your system-level settings.
- How it is stored: These values are read from the operating system on demand and immediately discarded. They are never stored and never transmitted.

Haptic Feedback (Vibration)
- What we access: The device's vibration capability.
- Why we access it: To provide a short vibration each time you count a Tasbih bead. This can be turned off at any time from the App's Settings.
- Transmission: Vibration is controlled entirely on your device. No data is generated, stored, or transmitted.

Sound
- What we access: The device's audio playback capability.
- Why we access it: To play a short click when you count a Tasbih bead. This can be turned off at any time from the App's Settings.
- Transmission: All click sounds are bundled with the App and played locally. No audio is recorded, no audio is streamed, and no data is transmitted.

Calendar (Prayer Reminders)
- What we access: A dedicated calendar account named "Sirat Companion" in your device's system calendar. When you enable prayer reminders, the App writes one calendar event per pending prayer for the next three days.
- Why we access it: To deliver prayer-time reminders through the system calendar, which fires reliably even when the App is not running.
- How it is stored: The events are stored by the system Calendar app under the App's own calendar account. The App reads events only from its own account, and only to remove stale events before rescheduling.
- Removal: You can remove all of these events at any time by turning off the master reminder toggle in Settings, or by deleting the "Sirat Companion" calendar account from the system Calendar app.

Maps Integration (Directions)
- What we access: When you tap "Get Directions" on a mosque, the App launches your device's default Maps application and passes the specific mosque's coordinates to it.
- Why we access it: To provide navigation to the selected mosque.
- Transmission: The App does not track your location or route. The handoff to the Maps app is subject to Huawei's or the Map provider's privacy policy.

Diagnostic Log
- What we access: A plain-text log file written by the app's own code, recording lifecycle events, errors, and warnings generated locally.
- Why we access it: To help diagnose issues reported by users. You can inspect, copy, or clear this file at any time from Settings.
- How it is stored: Stored locally on your device, inside the app's private sandbox. It is never transmitted to us or to any third party and is excluded from system backup.

Notification Features (Not Currently Active)
The App includes a native notification backend for prayer reminders. This backend is currently disabled while the Agent-Powered Reminder capability is pending approval by AppGallery Connect. While disabled, the App does not request the PUBLISH_AGENT_REMINDER permission and does not publish any notifications.

BACKUP AND RESTORE

Sirat Companion supports HarmonyOS's system-level backup framework. When backup is enabled on your device, the App's locally stored data (settings, Tasbih data, prayer history, cached GPS location, and any custom mosques you have created) is included in the system backup so it can be restored if you migrate to a new device.
- What is excluded: Downloaded mosque databases (`.db` files) and the diagnostic log file are deliberately excluded from backup to save space and prevent stale data. They will regenerate/re-download as needed.
- How it works: The backup is performed entirely by HarmonyOS and is subject to Huawei's privacy policy.

WHAT WE DO NOT COLLECT

Sirat Companion does not collect, store, or transmit:
- Your name, email address, phone number, or any account information
- Device identifiers (IMEI, MAC address, Advertising ID, or similar)
- Analytics or usage statistics
- Browsing history, contacts, photos, or files
- Financial or payment information
- Advertising identifiers

We do not use any third-party analytics SDKs, advertising SDKs, or tracking libraries.

SHARING OF INFORMATION

We do not share your personal information with anyone, because we never receive it. The App does interact with the following components:
- System geocoder and Location services (Huawei)
- Public CDN (jsDelivr / GitHub) — to download static OpenStreetMap mosque data. No personal data is sent.
- System Maps app (Huawei or third-party) — only when you explicitly tap "Get Directions".
- System Calendar, Audio, Vibration, and Backup services (Huawei)

DATA STORAGE AND RETENTION

All App data is stored locally on your device and is retained until you clear it from within the App or uninstall the App. Downloaded mosque databases can be deleted by clearing the app's cache or uninstalling. Calendar events can be deleted by turning off reminders or deleting the App's calendar account.

PERMISSIONS REQUESTED

- ohos.permission.INTERNET — To download offline mosque database files from the CDN.
- ohos.permission.VIBRATE — Haptic feedback while counting Tasbih.
- ohos.permission.APPROXIMATELY_LOCATION — Approximate location for prayer times and nearby mosques.
- ohos.permission.LOCATION — Precise location for prayer times and nearby mosques.
- ohos.permission.ACCELEROMETER — Compass and Qibla direction.
- ohos.permission.GYROSCOPE — Enhanced compass and Qibla direction.
- ohos.permission.READ_CALENDAR — Read the App's own calendar events to remove stale reminders.
- ohos.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR — Create prayer reminder events in the App's dedicated calendar account.

Permissions are requested only when you first use a feature that requires them.

SECURITY

Your local data is protected by the HarmonyOS app sandbox. Network requests to the CDN are strictly for downloading public, static data files and do not contain user identifiers or location data.

CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Sirat Companion is intended for general audiences and is suitable for users of all ages. The App does not knowingly collect any personal information from anyone.

YOUR RIGHTS

You have full control over your data at all times. Uninstalling the App removes all stored data. You can revoke permissions (including Internet and Location) in your device Settings.

CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

CONTACT US

If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: sharjeel.bhutt@gmail.com
Developer: Sharjeel Idris
